preconditions.description: The number of nodes n is between 2 and 200,000 inclusive.
The number of nodes k the teacher will inspect is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 1000000 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each time a_i used to build the i-th ball is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.
The number of edges is exactly n - 1, forming a tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct nodes within the range 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The maximum grade Jacob can get is between 1 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(min(a[i] for i in dfs_order[:k]) for root in range(1, n+1) for dfs_order in dfs_orders_from_root(root))
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum possible minimum time among the first k nodes in any DFS-order traversal starting from any root node.
